prompt: After resizing the window, the buttons look stretched and distorted. Why?
choices: GridLayout has a bug when resizing
GridLayout makes all cells equal-sized — as the window grows, all buttons stretch equally
There must be exactly 3 rows and 3 columns for GridLayout to work
explanation: GridLayout divides the container space equally among cells, so all buttons grow/shrink as the window resizes. If you want buttons at their preferred size in a row, use FlowLayout or BoxLayout instead. GridLayout is appropriate for calculator-style UIs where equal sizing is desired.
